fr.elements: Main Building; Secondary Building; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Internal Drive Aisle; Solar Panel System; Dumpster Enclosure; Open Area; Landscaped Area
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Multiple Structures; Outdoor Storage
fr.recommendations:
Based on the aerial observations provided, the following responder safety recommendations apply to this property:

• Mark the single access point with clearly visible address signage readable from both directions of approach.

• Post the address or unit identifier at the access point entrance so responding units can confirm the correct property without entering.

• Keep the internal drive aisle clear of parked vehicles and stored materials to allow emergency vehicles to reach both the main building and secondary building without obstruction.

• Mark a designated turnaround or staging area within the property so emergency vehicles are not forced to back out through the single access point.

• Identify and mark the secondary building with a visible building identifier distinct from the main building to prevent confusion during a multi-unit response.

• Keep the outdoor storage area organized and separated from building walls and doorways to maintain a clear path around both structures.

• Keep the dumpster enclosure gate fully closeable and position dumpsters so they do not block adjacent drive aisle access or building approaches.

• Mark the solar panel system location and any associated disconnect or shutoff with visible signage on or near the affected building exterior.

• Keep the vehicle parking area nearest to each building clear of long-term stored vehicles or materials that would limit emergency vehicle positioning close to either structure.

wildfire.conditions: Large Paved Area; Scattered Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Open Paved Area; Grass Cover; Vegetation Near Building; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Multiple Access Routes
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs and low branches on trees that are growing close to the building walls.
• Remove dry or dead grass accumulations directly against the building foundation.
• Keep the large paved area and open paved surfaces clear of dead leaves, grass clippings, and plant debris.
• Thin scattered shrubs where they are bunched close together near the building.
• Keep tree canopy trimmed back from rooflines and gutters where branches extend over the structure.
